fusions.name: Penning Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps the trowel round you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Raising the Byre
fusions.desc: Drives a beam end at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. When it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Winter Fold
fusions.desc: Marks out a fold 4 tiles across for 10 seconds; you and your allies inside it regain 3 health a second.

fusions.name: Barn-Warm Walls
fusions.desc: Your abilities' cooldowns are 6% shorter, your armour is 6% higher, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
